optional_metadata.identity_lane: compact human-readable lane such as R012, R005C, P017

rules: A taskbook defines work, not a particular conversation instance.
The executing conversation resolves or allocates its Researcher-ID at runtime before substantive work.
Multiple conversations may execute or continue the same taskbook with distinct Researcher-IDs.
A continuation in the same conversation preserves its existing Researcher-ID.
Legacy taskbooks without identity_policy inherit AUTO_RESOLVE_OR_ALLOCATE from the repository-level identity state machine.
Researcher identity never grants Driver authority or theorem ownership.
